name: Santa in the Train Station at the Hilliard Historical Village
venue: Historical Village and Museum at Weaver Park
paras: Destination Hilliard lists Santa in the Train Station at the Historical Village and Museum at Weaver Park on Sunday, December 13, from 2 to 5 PM. The village sits in downtown Hilliard at 4021 Main St, and admission is free with donations welcome.
Children share their Christmas wishes with Santa and Mrs. Claus at the village train station and red caboose. A horse drawn wagon ride and live holiday music add to the afternoon.

Inside the museum, kids walk through rooms decorated for Christmas, make a craft in the one room school and browse the gift shop. Every guest can pick up a complimentary cup of hot chocolate and a donut.
tip: Dress for the outdoors, since the wagon ride and the train station visit take place outside.

name: Santa in the Park at Bridge Park
venue: Pocket Park next to Rebol, Bridge Park
paras: The City of Dublin calendar lists Santa in the Park at Bridge Park on Saturday, December 5, from noon to 3 PM. Families visit the Pocket Park next to Rebol at 6568 Longshore St.
Kids and parents can take a free photo with Santa Claus and Mrs. Claus in the park.
Bridge Park also has North Pole mailboxes placed around the district, so children can drop off a letter to Santa while they are there.
tip: Bring a letter for Santa and drop it in one of the North Pole mailboxes around Bridge Park.
